name: Amamiya
source:
Developing one amazing new drug after another with intuition and inspiration. She is a genius(?) who is a threat to the world. She is both a doctor of medicine and pharmacology.

Talentwise, she's the real deal, but her sense of ethics is nonexistent. She administers her own drugs to patients without clinical trials.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/sakuseibyoto3/character/index.html]official site[/url]]
